picker_buttons: Blank note / An empty page — structure it your way.
BEFORE THE OPEN / Daily Game Plan / Regime, levels, scenarios, and your risk budget for the day.
AFTER THE CLOSE / Post-Market Debrief / Grade the day against the morning plan in five minutes.
SUNDAY OR MONDAY PREMARKET / Weekly Plan / Context, focus, A+ setups, and the risk plan for the week.
THE WEEKEND LOOK-BACK / Weekly Review / Patterns, leaks, and the ONE commitment for next week.
STARTING A NEW INVESTMENT THESIS / Long/Short Thesis / Bull case, bear case, catalysts, risks, and what would prove you wrong.
AFTER A TRADE CLOSES / Trade Post-Mortem / Setup, execution, and the lesson — while it’s fresh.
WHILE A POSITION IS OPEN / Swing Position Log / A dated block per day the position is alive — thesis, stop, action.
BEFORE A REPORT YOU CARE ABOUT / Earnings Play Plan / The report, the play, and sizing for binary risk.
WHEN IT GOES SIDEWAYS / Tilt Log / Three fields, sixty seconds. Naming it is the win.
